card.name: Digits in journal citation volumes and pages
card.fires_on: Single digits inside volume and page numbers of journal references, such as after 'Nature' or a journal abbreviation. It also fires on the space or parenthesis right after the journal name.

modes.label: Volume digits
modes.description: Digits of the volume number right after a journal name in a reference.

modes.label: Page range digits
modes.description: Digits within a page range after the colon in a citation.

modes.label: Space or bracket after journal
modes.description: The space or opening parenthesis between the journal name and the volume or issue.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens, which look unrelated to citations.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers in a journal reference, like the volume and page digits after a journal name.
